items.title: 'I have lost basically everything': Ex-AFL player opens up on compensation fight
items.description: Head trauma ended Aiden O'Driscoll's promising AFL career before he could play his first game. Now, like many former footballers affected by brain injuries, he faces an uncertain future as he fights for compensation.

items.title: This Jewish mother's child is greeted at school by security guards
items.description: Natalie Levy had an idyllic childhood growing up singing songs on Bondi Beach, but her children now attend school surrounded by heavy security and swastikas graffitied on buildings.

items.title: Live: US says it has sunk multiple Iranian boats, Trump issues fresh warning
items.description: A large fire has also broken out at key UAE oil port Fujairah, after it was hit by an Iranian drone attack. Follow live.

items.title: Two rescuers among three dead in boating accident on NSW coast
items.description: Marine Rescue NSW responds to a yacht in distress but its vessel rolls in heavy conditions.

items.title: Live: ASX in the red ahead of widely expected RBA interest rate hike
items.description: The RBA is widely forecast to deliver its third rate hike of 2026 this afternoon. The local share market is lower amid escalating tension in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Capital gains tax, negative gearing and trusts to form budget tax trio
items.description: The government is still finalising the details of its budget, but several sources say three tax policies that featured in Labor's 2019 election campaign will be revived and rethought.

items.title: Breaking: Jefferson Lewis excused from first court appearance since 5yo girl's death
items.description: The man accused of murdering five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby has been excused from appearing in court in the Northern Territory.

items.title: What we know about the virus suspected in deadly cruise ship outbreak
items.description: A rodent-borne illness is suspected of causing the deaths of three cruise ship passengers and leaving others sick. Here's what we know about the illness.

items.title: Met gala red carpet: How the stars interpreted 'fashion is art' dress code
items.description: A quick glance at the outfits from one of the fashion world's biggest events of the year.

items.title: RBA facing 'lesser-of-two-evils' choice between recession or inflation
items.description: If there's any certainty about the RBA's interest rate verdict, it's that it will be a split decision.

items.title: Woman, 60, dies in crash as driver in allegedly stolen car flees scene
items.description: Police arrest a man at a school that was sent into lockdown after he allegedly stole a car and caused a serious traffic crash that killed another driver north of Brisbane.

items.title: Cadbury development to be of 'international significance': Mayor
items.description: Glenorchy City Council has approved plans for a $150 million "chocolate experience" to be built at the Cadbury factory site in Claremont in Hobart's northern suburbs.

items.title: NDIS rorts cost taxpayers billions. This is how they happen
items.description: Insiders and participants say the NDIS is being targeted in similar ways around the country, including billing for services not provided, overcharging and in some cases "kidnapping" of vulnerable clients in order to park them in expensive supported accommodation and drain their plans.

items.title: Justin Baldoni and Blake Lively settle legal battle over It Ends With Us scandal
items.description: The pair settle their civil case two weeks before a trial had been set to begin in New York.

items.title: How did this boy from the bush become head of the highest court in the land?
items.description: The High Court makes decisions that impact us every day. So who is Stephen Gageler, the person overseeing it all? And how did he get here from a tiny town in regional NSW?

items.title: Australia urged to start providing cooked lunches in schools
items.description: Tasmania is "leading the way" with its largely state government-funded school lunch program. Now advocates are calling for a national rollout of the scheme, but warn parents may need to chip in.

items.title: Australia is experiencing HRT menopause patch shortages. Here's why
items.description: Supplies of some HRT patches may not return to normal until at least the end of the year. So what can patients do if they're impacted by shortages?

items.title: Another Melbourne nightclub targeted in 'terrifying' black market alcohol wars
items.description: La Di Da nightclub is the latest licensed venue to be targeted by arsonists in Melbourne, as industry representatives fear an escalation of black market alcohol wars.

items.title: Family's desperate plea to save boy's foot from rare tumour
items.description: Michele Dichiera is one of 20 children in the world with giant cell angioblastoma, but a life changing treatment could cost his family $9,500 per month.

items.title: Teen left behind after Vanuatu earthquake sues Commonwealth
items.description: A teenager with multiple disabilities stranded for days in Vanuatu's capital city after a deadly 2024 earthquake is taking the Australian government to the federal court for disability discrimination.

items.title: Formula 1's electrical revolution is losing its spark and V8 power could return
items.description: As drivers continue to raise objections to Formula 1's new electrical power era, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem has suggested a return to V8 power.

items.title: Man charged with rape and guilty of family violence ordained in Tasmanian church
items.description: A man who is facing a rape charge in Queensland — which he has pleaded not guilty to — has been appointed to a leadership role in a Tasmanian Seventh-day Adventist church.

items.title: Amid a housing crisis, this organisation says it has a quick fix
items.description: A community housing provider says it can get tenants into empty public houses and rapidly deliver new modular homes in WA's Mid West.

items.title: Hyena is all smiles with new gold-coloured crown over problem tooth
items.description: One of Monarto Safari Park's hyenas is flashing its new golden smile after a dental procedure to fix its deformed teeth and restore biting abilities.

items.title: Priest faces trial for allegedly sexually assaulting university student
items.description: A priest at two Wollongong parishes has been accused of sexually assaulting an international university student in 2019.
